description_en: Queries the template analysis job and returns a list of available preset templates when the template analysis job is complete
description_zh: 查询模板分析作业，模板分析作业完成后，返回可用的预置模板列表
name: QueryAnalysisJobList

parameters.help_en: The template analysis job ID list
parameters.help_zh:
模板分析作业ID列表。
一次最多查询10个。
多个使用半角逗号（,）作为分隔符
parameters.name: analysis_job_ids

AnalysisJob.description_en: The IDs of template analysis jobs

PropertiesControl.description_en: The control on the attributes of the job output

Crop.description_en: The cropping configuration of the video image

Height.description_en:
The height of the video image after the margins are cropped out.

This parameter is invalid if the Mode parameter is set to Auto or None
Height.description_zh:
裁切后高。

如果Mode为Auto或None，则此值失效

Left.description_en:
The left margin to be cropped out.

This parameter is invalid if the Mode parameter is set to Auto or None
Left.description_zh:
裁切左边距。

如果Mode为Auto或None，则此值失效

Mode.description_en:
The cropping mode. Valid values:

Auto: Cropping was automatically run.
Force: Cropping was forced to run.
None: Cropping was forced not to run.
This parameter is required if the value of the Crop parameter is not an empty JSON {}
Mode.description_zh:
裁切方式。取值：

Auto：自动。
Force：强制。
None：强制不做。
如Crop不是空JSON{}，则此值必填

Top.description_en:
The top margin to be cropped out.

This parameter is invalid if the Mode parameter is set to Auto or None
Top.description_zh:
裁切上边距。

如果Mode为Auto或None，则此值失效

Width.description_en:
The width of the video image after the margins are cropped out.

This parameter is invalid if the Mode parameter is set to Auto or None
Width.description_zh:
裁切后宽。

如果Mode为Auto或None，则此值失效

Deinterlace.description_en:
Specifies whether deinterlacing was forced to run. Valid values:

Auto: Deinterlacing was automatically run.
Force: Deinterlacing was forced to run.
None: Deinterlacing was forced not to run
Deinterlace.description_zh:
强制扫描模式判定。

Auto：自动。
Force：强制做deinterlace。
None：强制不做deinterlace

QualityControl.description_en: The quality control on the job output

MethodStreaming.description_en:
The playback mode. Valid values:

network: online playback.
local: playback on on-premises devices.
Default value: network
MethodStreaming.description_zh:
播放方式。

network：在线。

local：本地。

默认值：network

RateQuality.description_en: The quality level of the job output. Default value: 25

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the job fails

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the job was created

Id.description_en: The ID of the template analysis job

InputFile.description_en: The information about the job input

Bucket.description_en: The name of the OSS bucket in which the input file is stored

Location.description_en: The region in which OSS resides

Object.description_en: The name of the Object Storage Service (OSS) object that is used as the input file

MNSMessageResult.description_en: The message sent by Message Service (MNS) to notify users of the job result
MNSMessageResult.description_zh: MNS通知用户作业完成的结果

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the job failed. This parameter is not returned if the job was successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 失败时错误码。分析成功时不返回此参数

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the job failed. This parameter is not returned if the job was successful
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 失败时错误信息。分析成功时不返回此参数
ErrorMessage.example: The resource operated \"PipelineId\" cannot be found

MessageId.description_en: The ID of the message returned if the job was successful. This parameter is not returned if the job failed
MessageId.description_zh: 成功时消息ID。分析失败时不返回此参数

Message.description_en: The error message returned if the job failed
Message.example: The resource operated \"PipelineId\" cannot be found

PipelineId.description_en: The ID of the MPS queue to which the job was submitted

Priority.description_en:
The priority of the job in the ApsaraVideo Media Processing (MPS) queue to which the job was submitted.

Valid values: 1 to 10. The value 10 indicates the highest priority.
Default value: 10
Priority.description_zh:
任务在其对应管道内的优先级。
取值范围：[1,10]。10为最高优先级。
默认值：10

State.description_en:
The job status.

Submitted: The job was submitted.
Analyzing: The job is in progress.
Success: The job was successful.
Fail: The job failed
State.description_zh:
作业状态。

Submitted：已提交。

Analyzing：分析中。

Success：成功。

Fail：失败

Template.description_zh: 作业输出的预置模板列表

Bitrate.description_en:
The audio bitrate of the output file.

Valid values: 8 to 1000.
Unit: Kbit/s.
Default value: 128
Bitrate.description_zh:
输出文件的音频码率。
取值范围：8~1000。
单位：Kbps。
默认值：128

Channels.description_en: The number of sound channels. Default value: 2

Codec.description_en:
The audio codec. Default value: aac. Valid values:

aac
mp3
vorbis
flac
Codec.description_zh:
音频编解码格式。默认值：aac。可取值：

aac

mp3

vorbis

flac

Profile.description_en:
The codec profile of the audio. Valid values when the Codec parameter is set to aac:

aac_low
aac_he
aac_he_v2
aac_ld
aac_eld
Profile.description_zh:
音频编码预置。当Codec为aac时可取值：

aac_low

aac_he

aac_he_v2

aac_ld

aac_eld

Qscale.description_en: The level of quality control on the audio

Samplerate.description_en:
The sampling rate.

Unit: Hz.
Default value: 44100
Samplerate.description_zh:
采样率。
单位：Hz。
默认值：44100

Gif.description_en: The transmuxing configurations for the GIF format

FinalDelay.description_en: The interval between two consecutive loops for the GIF format. Unit: 0.01 second. For example, a value of 500 indicates 5 seconds
FinalDelay.description_zh: gif的loop间隔，单位为百分之一秒，比如500代表间隔为5秒

Loop.description_en: The number of loops for the GIF or WebP format. Default value: 0
Loop.description_zh: gif与webp循环次数，默认不循环

State.description_en:
The state of the template. Valid values:

Normal
Deleted
State.description_zh:
模板的状态。

Normal：正常。

Deleted：已删除

TransMode.description_en:
The transcoding mode. Default value: onepass. Valid values:

onepass
twopass
CBR
TransMode.description_zh:
转码模式。默认值：onepass。可选范围：

onepass

twopass

CBR

Bitrate.description_en: The average bitrate of the video. Unit: Kbit/s

BitrateBnd.description_en: The average bitrate range of the video

Max.description_en: The upper limit of the total bitrate. Unit: Kbit/s

Min.description_en: The lower limit of the total bitrate. Unit: Kbit/s

Bufsize.description_en:
The buffer size.

Unit: KB.
Default value: 6000
Bufsize.description_zh:
缓冲区大小。

单位：Kb。
默认值：6000

Codec.description_en: The codec. Valid values: H.264 and H.265. Default value: H.264
Codec.description_zh: 编解码格式。支持H.264、H.265。 默认值：H.264

Crf.description_en:
The constant rate factor.

Default value when the the Codec parameter is set to H.264: 23, default value when the the Codec parameter is set to H.265: 26.
If this parameter is specified, the value of the Bitrate parameter becomes invalid
Crf.description_zh:
码率-质量控制因子。
默认值：编码格式为H264，默认值为23。编码格式为H265，默认值为26。
如果设置了Crf，则Bitrate的设置失效

Degrain.description_en: The strength of the independent noise reduction algorithm

Fps.description_en:
The frame rate of the video.

The value is 60 if the frame rate of the input file exceeds 60.
Default value: the frame rate of the input video
Fps.description_zh:
帧率。
当输入文件帧率超过60时取60。
默认值：取输入文件帧率

Gop.description_en: The maximum number of frames between two keyframes. Default value: 250
Gop.description_zh: 关键帧间最大帧数。默认值：250

Height.description_en:
The height of the video.

Unit: pixel.
Default value: the height of the input video
Height.description_zh:
视频高。
单位：px。
默认值：视频原始高度

Maxrate.description_en:
The maximum bitrate of the video.

Valid values: 10 to 50000.
Unit: Kbit/s
Maxrate.description_zh:
视频码率峰值。

取值范围：[10,50000]。
单位：Kbps

PixFmt.description_en: The pixel format of the video. Valid values: standard pixel formats such as yuv420p and yuvj420p
PixFmt.description_zh: 视频颜色格式。包含yuv420p，yuvj420p等标准颜色格式

Preset.description_en: The preset video algorithm. Valid values: veryfast, fast, medium, slow, and slower. Default value: medium
Preset.description_zh: 视频算法器预置。支持veryfast（超快）、fast（快）、medium（中等）、slow（慢）、slower（超慢）。 默认值：medium

Profile.description_en:
The codec profile. Valid values:

baseline: applicable to mobile devices.
main: applicable to standard-definition devices.
high: applicable to high-definition devices.
Default value: high
Profile.description_zh:
编码级别。
baseline：针对移动设备。
main：针对标准分辨率设备。
high：针对高分辨率设备。
默认值：high

Qscale.description_en: The level of quality control on the video

ScanMode.description_en:
The scan mode. Valid values:

interlaced
progressive
ScanMode.description_zh:
扫描模式。取值：

interlaced：交叉扫描。

progressive：顺序扫描

Width.description_en:
The width of the video.

Unit: pixel.
Default value: the width of the input video
Width.description_zh:
视频宽。
单位：px。
默认值：视频原始宽度

String.description_en: The message sent by Message Service (MNS) to notify the user of the job result
String.description_zh: 不存在的模板分析作业

items.description_en: The operation that you want to perform. Set the value to QueryAnalysisJobList
items.description_zh: 不存在的模板分析作业ID列表，无数据时该结构不返回

RequestId.description_en:
The status of the job. Valid values:

Submitted: The job has been submitted.
Analyzing: The job is being run.
Success: The job is successful.
Fail: The job fails
